items.title: Nvidia has no obvious successor to Jensen Huang — and that's a problem
items.summary: Nvidia is coming under fire for having no clear succession plan to replace Jensen Huang in the event that something unexpected happens — like an international incident with him at the center. Why it matters: The spotlight on Huang shows the vulnerabilities of a large company being dependent on one executive — and the risks it poses to investors and customers, corporate governance experts tell Axio

items.title: Senator Tells Google to Let Schools Disable A.I. Features in Search
items.summary: The request came from Senator Edward J. Markey of Massachusetts, after Google said it would not turn off artificial intelligence tools for students using its search engine.
